text_block_list.text:
The day of the autumn grand stage had 
arrived, the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)', where 
I'd run alongside the junior I'd been 
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come for me to run 
with Spe-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at her past performances, it's 
clear she won't be an easy opponent to 
handle..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wh-ich-means, it's definitely gonna be a 
fun race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'm off! Trainer-kun, root 
for me, 'kay!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'm off! Trainer-chan, root 
for me, 'kay!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will definitely cross the line in 
first place!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*... *exhale*... *inhale*... 
*exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My, oh my, are you feeling nervous?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Maruzen-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm only just a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm enjoying every bit of it, 
including that. I just can't stop feeling 
excited.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because I get to see the back I've been 
chasing since before my debut right there 
on the same turf!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, being able to run in the same race 
as Spe-chan makes me truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, today I'm not looking at the back 
of my "idol"—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chase after my back as my "rival"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Rivals...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Understood. As your rival, I'll chase 
after you... and overtake you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let us enjoy it—the greatest race...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes!!
